nodes.title: Conditional surrogate risk

nodes.summary: Let $\varphi : \mathbb{R} \to [0, \infty)$ be convex and differentiable at $0$ with $\varphi'(0) < 0$. Then $\varphi$ is classification-calibrated.
nodes.title: Convex losses with negative slope at 0 are classification-calibrated

nodes.summary: A loss $\varphi$ is classification-calibrated if $H^-(\eta) > H(\eta)$ for every $\eta \in [0, 1]$ with $\eta \ne 1/2$: insisting on the wrong sign always costs conditional risk, a pointwise form of Fisher consistency for classification. The definition is meant for nonnegative (or at least bounded-below) losses, as in the source, which takes $\varphi : \mathbb{R} \to [0, \infty)$: the infima $H$ and $H^-$ are taken…
nodes.title: Classification-calibrated loss

nodes.summary: If $\varphi$ is nonnegative and convex, differentiable at $0$ with $\varphi'(0) < 0$, and $1/2 < \eta \le 1$, then $H(\eta) < H^-(\eta)$.
nodes.title: The case eta greater than one half

nodes.summary: $H(1 - \eta) = H(\eta)$ for every $\eta$, by the reflection $\alpha \mapsto -\alpha$.
nodes.title: Symmetry of the optimal risks

nodes.summary: $H(\eta) = \inf_{\alpha \in \mathbb{R}} C_\eta(\alpha)$, taken as an infimum in $\mathbb{R}$ (meaningful when $C_\eta$ is bounded below, as it is for a nonnegative loss and $\eta \in [0, 1]$).
nodes.title: Optimal conditional surrogate risk

nodes.summary: $H^-(1 - \eta) = H^-(\eta)$ for every $\eta$: the reflection $\alpha \mapsto -\alpha$ maps the constraint $\alpha(2(1-\eta) - 1) \le 0$ onto $\alpha(2\eta - 1) \le 0$.
nodes.title: Symmetry of the wrong-sign risks

nodes.summary: $H^-(\eta) = \inf \{ C_\eta(\alpha) : \alpha (2\eta - 1) \le 0 \}$, the best conditional risk when the sign of the prediction disagrees with that of $2\eta - 1$ (or the prediction is $0$).
